title: Introduction to Project Planning and Scheduling
description: This course aims to provide participants with an understanding of project planning and scheduling, strategic planning and control, the line of balance, ERP, and critical path methods.
longDescription: Understand Project Planning and Scheduling. Understand Strategic Planning and control. Learn about the Line of Balance. Concept of ERP and critical Path method. The aim of this course is to provide participants with an understanding of project planning and scheduling, strategic planning and control, the line of balance, ERP, and critical path method. Learners will learn about the essential tools and techniques used in project management to plan, schedule, and control projects successfully. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: The aim of this course is to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of project planning and scheduling, strategic planning and control, the line of balance, enterprise resource planning (ERP), and the critical path method (CPM). By the end of the module, learners will have gained the knowledge and skills required to effectively plan, execute, and control projects in a variety of industries.
